Olivia K: quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:40 alert storm. want a tiny plan to reduce pages without losing hit visibility.
Marco D: short & reversible only. no global silences.
Olivia K: proposed checklist: 1) narrow thresholds for top-5 offenders (trial 7d), 2) per-service dedupe signature, 3) add short maintenance suppression keyed to job_id, 4) start a 2-weekly 3-alert sweep after rollout.
Zoe H: i can own the dedupe config. plan: consolidation 2m + suppression 18m for identical signature. signature = "{{service}}:{{metric_group}}:{{bucket}}". will test in staging.
Marco D: i'll run 60-day percentiles and return a PR with suggested cutoffs + expected page reduction and FN notes. 48h turnaround.
tune-bot: (automated) Incident#5981 resolved by olivia.k  follow-up task 'pager-slimdown-5981' created
Olivia K: owners & dates: Zoe - dedupe PR + staging tests due 2025-04-10; Marco - threshold analysis PR due 2025-04-09; Olivia - canary plan & runbook update due 2025-04-11.
Zoe H: i'll tag tuned alerts with label "tuned-apr2025" and add a 10-day banner in Slack notif so oncall knows it's tuned.
Marco D: i'll include dashboards, trend CSV, and expected page delta in PR. will call out any risky cutoffs.
Olivia K: please reply 'ack' after you add tasks to the board and link PRs here. i'll move tasks to In Progress.
Marco D: ackwill link PR
Zoe H: ack - PR link when ready
Olivia K: thanks 44d I'll brief oncall before the canary.
